From the kitchen

Photos from the restaurant’s own Google listing.

A Cypriot corner on Ikarou street

To Eklekton Cypriot Corner sits on Ikarou street in Kato Paphos: a small taverna with white tablecloths, run by Mohammed, who greets his guests himself. On Google, guests mention the Cypriot food and the meze most of all, then the large portions, the moussaka, the baklava and the welcoming staff, and many write about the dessert that comes from the house at the end.

Open every day from half past twelve at noon until two at night. Dine in, take away or delivery.

What guests say

Two of 955 Google reviews, 4.8 stars on average.

“This place was one of the highlights of our trip to Paphos. The food feels truly homemade and authentic - you can tell everything is prepared fresh just for you. The meat and fries are cooked to order, not pre-made, which makes a huge difference in taste and quality. The staff are incredibly welcoming, and the owner personally comes to greet and chat with guests, which creates such a warm and personal atmosphere. At the end of the meal, they even treat you to a complimentary dessert ... Out of all the places we visited, this one truly stood out. Highly recommend!”
Olesia Cherepova · Google review
“We had a wonderful dining experience here. The meze was absolutely delicious, with a great variety of fresh and flavorful dishes that allowed us to experience the best of Cypriot cuisine. What made the evening even better was the excellent service. The staff were friendly, attentive, and made us feel genuinely welcome throughout our visit. Their recommendations were spot on, and they ensured everything was perfect from start to finish. Highly recommended for anyone looking for authentic food, generous portions, and outstanding hospitality. We will definitely return next time we are in Paphos!”
Bartek · Google review
